option.dynmap-draw.enable_dynmap_draw_hu: Shows the corner count and /dl command hints while drawing Dynmap lines.
option.dynmap-draw.dynmap_export_path.to: Folder for pending_marker_*.json exports in dynmap marker format (sets/lines). Leave empty for .minecraft/config/dynmap-draw/exports. Relative paths are resolved from the game directory.
option.dynmap-draw.dynmap_corner_from_cr: When on, attack/use and /dl addcorner use the block or entity your crosshair is pointing at. When off, they use your player position. If nothing is targeted, your position is used.
option.dynmap-draw.dynmap_preview_url.to: Base URL for dynmap tiles and configuration used by the local preview (e.g. https://dynmap.minecartrapidtransit.net/main/).
